name: Perplexity

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: Optional PyPI package: perplexityai (install via anysearch-sdk extra `perplexity`).

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Search API `results[].snippet`. Sonar has no ranked snippet list — use Search API or citations.

domains.comment: `search_domain_filter` on Search API and Sonar (allowlist or `-domain` denylist).

country.comment: Search API has no `gl` country param; Sonar supports regional bias via search options.

language.comment: `search_language_filter` on Search API (ISO 639-1). Not exposed on Sonar chat requests.

answer.comment: Sonar assistant message — synthesized prose with citations (`/chat/completions`). Search API returns raw `results[]` only (no LLM answer field).

content.comment: Search API: larger `snippet` via `snippet_mode`, `max_tokens`, `max_tokens_per_page`. Sonar does not return full page bodies.

mode.comment: **Search API** (`POST /search`) → matrix `balanced`: raw ranked `results[]` (anysearch SDK). **Sonar** (`POST /chat/completions`) → model `sonar`→balanced (grounded answer + citations), `sonar-pro`→deep (multi-source research synthesis). Same `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY`.

pricing_per_1k.value: Fast $1; Standard $5 / 1K requests (up to 5 queries/request); no raw Search model tokens
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Standard $5; up to five queries per request

free_tier_limits.value: No general free API allowance verified
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: Search: 0.35s p50 / 0.47s p95 independent; 0.358s p50 / 0.763s p95 provider; Sonar/deep: not published
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. Independent figures use three 2,000-query runs from the US East Coast. Perplexity's reproducible 2025 vendor benchmark ran from AWS us-east-1.

notes: Native SDK package: perplexityai. Search API (`POST /search`) is in the anysearch SDK; Sonar (`POST /chat/completions`) is documented in the matrix but not wired in the SDK yet.

native_api.value: Ranked Search results and extracted text; Sonar, Agent and Research are separate model-mediated products. Empty HTTP-200 responses are billable.

rate_limits.value: 1–20 results; other account limits per docs

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
